DICETHESPIRE-SCRAP.description: At the end of combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] cards to remove from your deck. Obtain its [gold]Gadget[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-SCRAP.title: Scrap
DICETHESPIRE-TEMPORARY_GADGET.descriptio: A [gold]Gadget[/gold] that lasts until the end of combat. Does not require scrapping an additional card.
DICETHESPIRE-TEMPORARY_GADGET.title: Temporary Gadget
DICETHESPIRE-GADGET.description: Gadgets are items that passively provide you with powerful abilities, but are destroyed after a period of time.
